entities.name: Arzuna
entities.description: A vampire anti-hero with heightened senses who enforces strict rules on herself against drinking innocent or demon blood.
entities.quote: Arzuna, the former villain, the vampire anti-hero, the lone wolf who trusts nobody

entities.name: Samuel Sterling
entities.description: A calculated operative who utilizes a soft-state tie capable of hardening into a razor-sharp blade, whip, or spear in combat.

entities.name: Aariz
entities.description: An individual whose blood Arzuna accidentally drank, sharpening her vampiric instincts.
entities.quote: since she drank Aariz’s blood by mistake and survived herself afterward

entities.name: Stitch
entities.description: A deceased figure responsible for creating augmented bone and metal human creations.
entities.quote: Stitch is dead, but his sins have legs.

timeline_events.title: Tie the Knife
timeline_events.description: Samuel Sterling arrives at a ruined army camp to assist Arzuna in defeating augmented creations and a demonic-blood experiment.
timeline_events.quote: EPISODE SEGMENT — “Tie the Knife” (Season 4 | Arzuna × Samuel — Part 2)
